sources.finding: Transfer students may enter both school static files, but graduation and dropout indicators are explicitly excluded from that static file and reported separately.
sources.applicability: Excludes use of static-file duplication as an explanation of graduation cohort difference; not a finding that graduation records are duplicate-free.

sources.finding: Five-year cohort training assigns concurrent enrollments to the diploma-granting school and transfers to the new school.
sources.applicability: Five-year rule, no actual cohort2024 four-year cross-level reconciliation; publication/effective date not verified from PDF bytes.

conclusion: No numerical interval shrink is supported. Net difference2 is not a duplicate-count budget.
